svg.title: Recovery-time CDF after a carrier failure
svg.desc: Empirical CDF per system over 30 seeds of at06_drone_failure.
svg.text: Recovery after a carrier failure (empirical CDF)
at06_drone_failure, 30 seeds per system: the first carrier after 120 s is killed 10 s after its pickup. Curves stay below 1 for runs never recovered.
pact declares from physical evidence (failure quorum); baselines re-order after a fixed 60 s stand-in. Every system re-orders the parcel as priority 1 with a fresh window.
